sources.title: Own rendered SVG and personal visual inspection
Own six-position visibility count derivation
sources.details: Rows=queries, columns=keys. Full j<=i gives 6*7/2=21. Width 3 includes self: 1+2+4*3=15. Fixed groups floor(i/3)==floor(j/3), causal: 2*(1+2+3)=12. Each grid is 6x6=36 possible cells. Position 3: full0..3/sliding1..3/chunk3; position4: full0..4/sliding2..4/chunk3..4. Counts concern direct allowed pairs, with exact integer equality, not timing or accuracy.
